company: Decagon was founded in 2023 by Jesse Zhang and Ashwin Sreenivas. It builds AI agents that answer and resolve customer-support requests for companies including Chime, and competes directly with Sierra.

In January 2026 Decagon raised a $250 million Series D at a $4.5 billion valuation, roughly triple its previous round, with Coatue, Index and a16z among the investors. In March 2026 those investors led an employee tender offer at the same valuation.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Decagon, alongside Sierra, is a leading test of AI agents replacing customer-support work, and of how many winners that market can support.
